name: Run an assigned task
description: The execution loop of the task board: when a task is assigned to an AI agent, acknowledge by moving it to In progress, then RUN the agent against the task and park the result at In review for a human. On failure the task auto-rolls back to To do with an explanatory comment. Guardrail refusals (concurrency queue, budget pause, circuit breaker) skip the error comment — the guardrails already posted a more specific one. Tune or disable per org: this file is yours to edit, and the trigger can be deactivated on the workflow's Triggers tab. Agents bound to an external runtime (tale-daemon) dispatch instead of running inline: the task stays In progress until the daemon reports back (its completion moves the task to In review; failures roll back automatically).

parameters.instructions: You have been assigned this task on the project board. Do the work it describes to the best of your ability with the tools available, then post your final result as a task comment. Keep the result concise and reviewable — a human will review it next.

config.description: Internal runs park at In review now; external dispatches return immediately and the daemon's completion does it later.
External work is asynchronous — leave the task In progress; the daemon completes it to In review (or the dispatch watchdog rolls it back).
Guardrail refusals already posted their own specific comment (queued / budget / breaker) — roll back quietly. Real failures get an explanatory comment.
